t: Magnusson sanding block is a 70 x 125mm manual hand sander for efficient surface preparation. Features a flexible foam construction which adapts to contours and irregular surfaces, providing even pressure and consistent results. Suitable for both flat and curved surfaces. Ideal for use by trade professionals such as painters and decorators when smoothing painted woodwork, plaster, and softwoods and before applying topcoats. The ergonomic design provides a comfortable grip that reduces hand fatigue during extended trade use. The durable sanding block is supplied with 10 sanding sheets: 1x 40 Grit, 3x 80 Grit, 3x 120 Grit and 3x 180 Grit.
b: Supplied With 40, 80, 120 and 180 Grit Sanding Papers
